references.text: Basic law concerning cities of refuge where someone who kills another by accident can flee and be safe from the avenger of blood
Cities of refuge were for anyone who killed a person unintentionally, both Israelites and foreigners
Describes the difference between intentional murder and accidental killing, and the role of the avenger of blood
Moses designated cities of refuge for someone who kills their neighbor unintentionally and without prior enmity
Detailed description of who may flee to the cities of refuge - anyone who kills another unintentionally and without hatred
The purpose of the cities of refuge was to prevent innocent blood from being shed
Early legislation regarding a place of refuge for someone who kills unintentionally - God will appoint a place
Concluding summary of the purpose of the cities of refuge for someone who kills by accident
New Testament parallel about fleeing to seize the hope set before us, a spiritual refuge
